plate edge (unnamed stub north of Hanfield Street)

notes: Hanfield Street runs along the top plate edge; its north side is cut by the plate edge, so its centre was taken on the 6 in. water pipe line, which sits midway between the plate edge and the south frontage where both show (x 6700, x 7430). The name is printed outside the strip (…NFIELD to the west, STREET to the east). Gordon Street continues as a short stub north of Hanfield (name not printed on the stub; taken as Gordon, same west line). The stub at x 6708 is unnamed on the plate (12 in. sewer in it). The street north of Hanfield in line with Witler prints only 'ST.' in my area; taken as Witler Street. Colerain / Blue Rock is a Y: Colerain comes in from the north-west and turns south-south-east, Blue Rock continues east-south-east; the pick is where the three centre lines meet. Joe Williams Street is 35 ft wide at its Colerain end (55 ft printed further east). Powers Street: name not printed inside the strip, south side cut by the bottom plate edge; centre taken 75 px (half of 50 ft) below the north frontage, on the pipe line; Borden not seen continuing south (plate edge). Borden Street ends at Hoffner Avenue (cemetery north of it). An unnamed 10 ft strip runs east from Borden at y about 6795 along the north side of the Thiering lots (not picked). Railroad crosses Powers at x 7600-7850 (not a street). No cross streets on Colerain between Joe Williams and x 7520; Wesleyan Cemetery lies west of it.
